Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Economics BSc at King's College London

What King's College London asks of applicants to Economics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All King's College London courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma, Route 1 (offer level A*AA): three APs at 5 (or permitted Honors/Dual Enrolment classes, IB Higher Levels or A-levels) plus ACT 29 or SAT 1380 (minimum 620 Maths, 650 Reading and Writing)
  • Route 2 needs no SAT/ACT: five APs at 55554
  • SAT subject tests and ACT/SAT superscores are not considered
Verified19 Oct 2026King’s: Undergraduate entry requirements
English language
  • English language band B (2027/28 entry)
  • IELTS Academic (or IELTS Online): 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each skill
  • TOEFL iBT: 100 overall with at least 25 in writing and 23 in each other skill (tests taken from 21 January 2026: 5 overall, at least 4.5 in each skill)
  • PTE Academic: 69 overall with at least 62 in each communicative skill
  • Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency: 185 overall with at least 176 in each skill
  • All scores from one test; tests valid within two years of the course start

Nationals of listed majority English-speaking countries (including the USA) who completed an A-level-equivalent qualification in such a country need no additional test.

Verified19 Oct 2026King’s: Economics BSc – Entry Requirements · King’s: Undergraduate English language entry requirements
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

King’s lists aptitude tests only for Law/PPL (LNAT), Dentistry/Medicine (UCAT) and Dental Therapy & Hygiene (Casper).
